metadata.question: Does the built-up area in Dublin increase from November 1984 to November 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Dublin, Ireland (~53.35°N, -6.26°W) - Time periods: November 1984 and November 2022 - Collection: For 1984, use Landsat 5 (LT05). For 2022, use Landsat 8 or 9 (LC08/LC09) - Built-up area detection: Use NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or simple band ratios 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we're looking at built-up area changes - Use QA bands for cloud masking 3. Logic: - Valid result: Both periods have data, can calculate built-up area - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Built-up area increased (2022 > 1984) - B: Built-up area did not increase (2022 <= 1984) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Dublin geometry and time periods const dublin = ee.Geometry.Point([-6.26, 53.35]).buffer(15000); // 15km radius const date1984Start = '1984-11-01'; const date1984End = '1984-11-30'; const date2022Start = '2022-11-01'; const date2022End = '2022-11-30'; // 2. Cloud masking functions function maskL5(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function maskL8(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Load Landsat 5 for 1984 let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(dublin) .filterDate(date1984Start, date1984End) .map(maskL5); const size1984 = await col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images found: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log('No data for November 1984.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Load Landsat 8/9 for 2022 let col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(dublin) .filterDate(date2022Start, date2022End) .map(maskL8); let size2022 = await col2022.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images found (L9): ${size2022}`); if (size2022 === 0) { col2022 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(dublin) .filterDate(date2022Start, date2022End) .map(maskL8); size2022 = await col2022.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images found (L8): ${size2022}`); } if (size2022 === 0) { console.log('No data for November 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate NDBI (Built-up index) = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) function addNDBI_L5(image) { const ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); return image.addBands(ndbi); } function addNDBI_L8(image) { const ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI'); return image.addBands(ndbi); } const img1984 = col1984.map(addNDBI_L5).select('NDBI').median(); const img2022 = col2022.map(addNDBI_L8).select('NDBI').median(); // 6. Calculate built-up area (NDBI > 0 threshold) const builtup1984 = img1984.gt(0); const builtup2022 = img2022.gt(0); // 7. Check valid pixels const count1984Result = await builtup1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dublin, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2022Result = await builtup2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dublin, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1984 = count1984Result.NDBI || 0; const count2022 = count2022Result.NDBI || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels 1984: ${count1984}, 2022: ${count2022}`); if (count1984 === 0 || count2022 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Calculate built-up area in pixels const area1984Result = await builtup1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: dublin, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const area2022Result = await builtup2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: dublin, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const area1984 = area1984Result.NDBI; const area2022 = area2022Result.NDBI; console.log(`Built-up pixels 1984: ${area1984}`); console.log(`Built-up pixels 2022: ${area2022}`); if (area1984 === null || area1984 === undefined || area2022 === null || area2022 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Final answer if (area2022 > area1984) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
